name: Template F: Open and Distance Learning (ODL) and Online Programs Approval
description: Approval workflow for institutions offering technical programs via Open and Distance Learning (ODL) or Online mode, requiring compliance with UGC-DEB equivalence and LMS infrastructure.
statutoryConstraints: Institution must hold valid NAAC score >= 3.26 or NIRF Top-100 ranking
LMS data centers must be located within sovereign territory of India
Maximum intake is governed by AICTE national ODL guidelines
